All parent terms (k_on*L*R drives startup ~15; k_off*C(1+alpha*C) and k_iso_rev*C_star provide reverse; k_iso_cat*C_star*C provides autocatalysis) remain finite and non-degenerate over the same window.

rationale: Standard binding + reversible-isomerization ODE system with a new Arrhenius-style modulation on the forward isomerization (E-parent factor = exp(-E_strain/(k_B_eff+gamma_relax*C_star)) − 1). Parameters chosen inside the pipeline's suggested magnitudes: E_strain=1.0, k_B_eff=0.6 give a moderate initial barrier exp(-1/0.6)≈0.19 that softens toward exp(-1/(0.6+0.8*C_star)) as C_star grows, so the new term's signature is largest during the rise-to-plateau window and rides on top of the parent's linear (1+beta_iso*C_star) factor. k_on=1, k_off=0.3 give a healthy forward drive with reversible dissociation and mild self-cooperativity (alpha=0.2). k_iso=0.4 with the exp prefactor yields net isomerization on a timescale of a few units; k_iso_rev=0.05 and k_iso_cat=0.03 keep reverse and autocatalysis modest. Range t∈[0,30] with 250 points comfortably covers rise (~t≈3), overshoot, and plateau. Noise σ=0.05 on the C-RHS scale is small vs the driving term (~15 initially, ~0.1–1 during equilibration) and gives a 20.85σ new-term signal on the full ODE-system trajectory comparison — clearly above the 5σ visibility bar.
